title: Compare PDF Files Visually — Find Pixel Differences
description: Upload two PDF documents and instantly highlight the exact pixel differences between them locally in your browser.

sections.title: Spot Tiny Changes Automatically
sections.content: Don't rely on your eyes to find differences in revised contracts or designs. Our tool highlights exact pixel changes in red.

sections.title: How to Compare PDFs
sections.content: Upload the original PDF and the revised PDF. We'll render both and overlap them to expose any additions or deletions.

sections.title: Perfect for Contracts & Proofs
sections.content: Lawyers and designers use our visual diff tool to ensure no unauthorized changes were snuck into a document.

sections.title: Confidential Document Comparison
sections.content: Comparing sensitive NDA contracts? Our tool is 100% local. The documents never touch our servers.

sections.title: Real-Time Diff Rendering
sections.content: Generate visual diffs instantly in your browser thanks to hardware-accelerated canvas rendering.

faqs.q: Does it find text or pixel differences?
faqs.a: It renders the PDF and finds visual pixel differences, which includes text, fonts, and images.

faqs.q: What do the red marks mean?
faqs.a: Red highlights indicate areas where the two PDFs differ visually.

faqs.q: Is it safe for legal documents?
faqs.a: Yes, all processing is strictly local and private.
